blog_title: ₹85 Plain T-Shirt Quality Check — 5 Things That Make Cheap Tees Look Brand Level for DTF Print
caption:
₹85 tee ordered 300 pieces. Client said it looked cheap after DTF print. 😬

We learned the hard way: collar rib must be 1x1, fabric needs 200+ GSM, biowash matters, side seams can't twist, and ring-spun combed cotton prints clean.

Check these 5 before your next bulk order.

Save this if you're sourcing blanks for printing 👇
